name: Acanthus Scroll
desc: The classical running scroll (rinceau) -- stacked bands of alternating volutes uncurl across the frame, each spiral eye wrapped in a cluster of deeply-cut acanthus leaves; the whole relief is modelled purely by a raking light that slowly wheels around, so every lobe's lit and shadowed faces trade places and the carved stone never sits still, rendered as limestone chiaroscuro, gilded carving, terracotta bronze, or a line engraving.

energy.doc: highlight glow and lit-face brightness of the carving

scale.doc: size of the volutes and leaf fans -- bigger, fewer, more monumental

speed.doc: how fast the raking light wheels and the leaf tips uncurl

density.doc: number of scroll bands and volutes per band

relief.doc: depth of the carved relief -- shadow-to-highlight separation

style.doc: aesthetic: limestone chiaroscuro relief / gilded carving on dark / terracotta and bronze / monochrome line engraving with hatching

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws volute turns, curl directions and leaf fans
